text: The Aushopping.com website is published by Nhood Services France (Villeneuve d'Ascq, RCS Lille Métropole 534 886 411), which also publishes the Nhood France website; RC Lens describes Aushopping as the network brand of Auchan's shopping centres in France. New Immo Holding is the holding company of Foncière Ceetrus and of Nhood, a real-estate services platform created in 2021.
short: Aushopping is run by Nhood Services France; Nhood is held by New Immo Holding
